name: Monke Mash!
summary:
🦍 Monke Mash!
The ultimate VR hangout — with monkes, mayhem, and a touch of zero-G.

Welcome to Monke Mash!, a social VR experience where you and your friends can laugh, explore, and chill together as playful monkes. Climb, bounce, and swing through a variety of fun zones — from grounded hangout spots to a wild zero-gravity room where things get... floaty.

Built for the Meta Horizon Store, Monke Mash! is all about good vibes, goofy moments, and unforgettable memories with your troop.
